attributes.name: Druva - Backup Retention Reduced or Removed
attributes.description: Detects administrative events indicating that backup retention may have been reduced, shortened, removed, disabled, or deleted. Candidate rule pending final semantic validation.
author: Druva
false_positives: Approved retention-policy reduction due to business or compliance changes.
Migration to a different retention model or storage tier.
Cleanup of obsolete, test, or decommissioned workloads.
attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and (
  druva.event_type:"Backup Retention Reduced"
  or druva.event_type:"Backup Retention Removed"
)
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects administrative activity indicating that Druva backup retention was reduced or removed. Reduced retention can shorten the recovery window available after destructive activity.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the affected policy, workload, or resource and the administrator responsible.
- Determine the previous and new retention configuration where available.
- Confirm that the change was approved by the appropriate data owner or policy owner.
- Review nearby backup-protection, repository, storage-target, permission, and deletion events.
- Check for UDA, ransomware, suspicious authentication, or privilege changes preceding the retention modification.
- Determine which recovery points may expire or become unavailable because of the change.

#### Response

- Restore required retention when the change was unauthorized or incorrect.
- Preserve critical recovery points when possible.
- Investigate the responsible administrator if the activity cannot be validated.
